instruction: I have difficulty using a physical keyboard. Open the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and leave it available for me. Save the FIFA World Cup winner and final-match host country for 2022, 2018, and 2014 to `answer.txt` on the Desktop in three lines ordered by year from 2022 to 2014. Use the format `Winner {Year}: {Winner} and Host Country {Year}: {Host Country}` for each line.
gt_steps: Keep the On-Screen Keyboard open throughout the task.
Find the winner of the 2022 FIFA World Cup.
Find the country that hosted the 2022 FIFA World Cup Final.
Find the winner of the 2018 FIFA World Cup.
Find the country that hosted the 2018 FIFA World Cup Final.
Find the winner of the 2014 FIFA World Cup.
Find the country that hosted the 2014 FIFA World Cup Final.
Write `Winner 2022: Argentina and Host Country 2022: Qatar` on the first line.
Write `Winner 2018: France and Host Country 2018: Russia` on the second line.
Write `Winner 2014: Germany and Host Country 2014: Brazil` on the third line.
Save the file as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$osk = Get-Process -Name osk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 }; if ($osk) { Write-Output 'OSK_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'OSK_NOT_OPEN' }"

result.textcontent:
Winner 2022: Argentina and Host Country 2022: Qatar
Winner 2018: France and Host Country 2018: Russia
Winner 2014: Germany and Host Country 2014: Brazil
